hebrewText: אַל תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨י/ךָ מִמֶּ/נִּי֮ אַֽל תַּט בְּ/אַ֗ף עַ֫בְדֶּ֥/ךָ עֶזְרָתִ֥/י הָיִ֑יתָ אַֽל תִּטְּשֵׁ֥/נִי וְ/אַל תַּֽ֝עַזְבֵ֗/נִי אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽ/י

tokens.bdb: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
tokens.kjv: nay, neither, [phrase] never, no, nor, not, nothing (worth), rather than.

tokens.bdb: to hide (by covering), literally or figuratively
tokens.kjv: be absent, keep close, conceal, hide (self), (keep) secret, [idiom] surely.
